method: one set-consistent utility for complete instance and category-menu answers
fit_category_episodes: full map and three fixed view-disjoint folds, equally weighted within each room
calibration_development_category_episode: full-map episode only; no fold chosen by utility
category_training_target: mean of complete-menu mIoU on 19/15/10 submenus; same candidate for all
balancing: equal room and task; equal query within a room/task; equal candidate within a query
calibration: one shared margin; protect each room/output cell: text IoU, image IoU, category mIoU19/15/10; 15 cells total; maximize equal-cell gain
features: same 39-component signature; category signature averages all 19 classes without labels; task and provider IDs never enter learner
learner_capacity: unchanged from parent; set-conditioned scalar value, centered actual utility target
